Assalamu alaikum, i would like to know the meaning of a dream that a friend of mine had. recently her mother passed away, after her mother passed away close friends and relatives told her often that they see her mother in their dreams. after hearing this from her friends she prayed to Allah asking Allah that she wants to see her mother in her dream.That night she had a dream about her mother, in the dream she saw that her mother was buried, but family members and other people had to get her out becuase she was going to have a baby, after her mother was brought out, her mother was taken to the hospital to have her baby, theN she saw that she was running to see her mother, but she was told by doctors that her mother was in the hospital basement, so she ran to the basement but when she got there she saw her mother in a bag the way she was when she first died. My friend would like to know the meaning of this dream. Jazakallah 2191 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 57436 Country: India Title: کیا اسلام میں سیکولرزم جائز ہے یا نہیں؟ Question: کیا اسلام میں سیکولرزم جائز ہے یا نہیں؟ Answer ID: 57436 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 287-275/H=4/1436-U سیکولرزم (موجودہ زمانہ میں جو جمہوریت کا طور طریق اورانداز دنیا میں رائج ہے) اور مذہبِ اسلام میں جمہوریت کا مفہوم ومطلب ایک نہیں ہے، موجودہ جمہوری نظام میں سروں کی گنتی اصل ہے اور اسلامی جمہوریت میں قوةِ دلیل کا اعتبار ہوتا ہے، الغرض دونوں کی جمہوریت کی حقیقت معنی ومفہوم علیحدہ علیحدہ ہیں۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
